anchorOrder: LINEAR, the 014 round-3 order: (1) harness/STUDY-MANIFEST.sha256 covers the protocol documents, both matrix strata, every registry/ and harness/ source file, the harness tests, both vendored pack fixtures and every per-cell fixture manifest of the locked stratum, and covers NEITHER itself NOR this file; (2) this file pins that manifest's digest in studyManifest.sha256; (3) the freeze commit - together with the pinsRawSha256 stamp every attempt record carries (SHA-256 of this file's raw bytes, computed before the parse) - anchors this file.
registeredLabelRule: harness/score.py labels an attempt REGISTERED only when EVERY freeze pin is non-null - preregistration, matrix, matrixHoldout, registrySpec, studyManifest. Any null makes it a PILOT. The non-null ones are enforced under both labels.

registryAuthority.note: Study-minted, fixed-seed Ed25519 - a trust root of the apparatus, stated as such (the authority's independence is asserted by no one; the seeds are public deterministic fixtures, and nothing anywhere depends on their secrecy). Seeds: sha256 of the labels below. TWO trust roots are registered (round-1 R1-10; the draft's one-genesis-serves-the-matrix claim is withdrawn): genesisHead is the digest of the canonical [add expense-approval 0.1.0 @2026-01-01] checkpoint, shared by every expense-series history in the matrix; otherSeriesGenesisHead is the digest of the other-policy log's genesis, pinned by cur-series-unknown's trust configuration. Trust configurations are per-series (trustconfig.seriesId binds which series the pins confer authority over) and their minimumHeadPin member is caller-provisioned prior-acceptance state, not verifier-persisted storage (round-1 R1-5). Every member here is mechanically recomputed and compared by the scorer before adjudication.

harnessPython.note: harness code runs in the same venv as the openworkproof package; the registry modules use rfc8785 and cryptography from that venv

matrix.note: locked-replication cell expectations; digest filled at the freeze together with the preregistration digest. The frozen cell-id set is additionally asserted in harness/score.py, so a reduced registry cannot satisfy zero divergence

matrixHoldout.note: reviewer-authored holdout stratum, to be authored during the cross-vendor review rounds and committed verbatim with attribution, never executed pre-freeze; digest filled at the freeze. score.py --include-holdout is refused mechanically while preregistration.sha256 is null AND while this digest is null

registrySpec.note: the registered checkpoint/snapshot schema and Layer CURRENCY ceremony; registered with the preregistration, digest filled at the freeze
